summary: This note is a short biography of Graeme Goodall (1932 – 3 December 2014), an Australian recording engineer and record label owner. It describes his central role in the early development of Jamaica's recording industry, including building several studios on the island and co-founding Island Records. It also notes that he operated other UK labels that released Jamaican music.
one_line: Graeme Goodall was an Australian recording engineer and label owner who helped build Jamaica's early recording industry and co-founded Island Records.
key_facts: Graeme Goodall was born in 1932 and died on 3 December 2014.
Graeme Goodall was an Australian recording engineer and record label owner.
Graeme Goodall was a key figure in the early days of Jamaica's recording industry.
Graeme Goodall constructed several recording studios on Jamaica.
Graeme Goodall operated other labels in the United Kingdom that released Jamaican music.
